create_Timeline: create a Timeline object with epoch, round, and rounds_per_epoch to track simulation progress
test_global_round_num: test the Timeline global_round_num method to calculate the global round number from epoch and round
test_as_float: test the Timeline as_float method to convert the current timeline position to a floating point value
test_tick: test the Timeline tick method to determine when to report results at regular epoch intervals
test_progress_fraction: test the Timeline progress_fraction method to calculate the fraction of total simulation completed
